root_cause.text: ath12k’s `ath12k_mac_op_change_vif_links()` failed to clear `ahvif->links_map` when a link was only initialized but `arvif->is_created` was still false, leaving a stale link-to-`arvif` mapping in the ath12k MLO/VIF link management path.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE says the error path “attempts to delete all links” but “link deletion only executes when `arvif->is_created` is true,” so `ahvif` keeps a stale initialized-but-not-created mapping; the patch fixes this by adding `ath12k_mac_unassign_link_vif(arvif);` inside `if (!arvif->is_created) { ... continue; }`, explicitly clearing the stale mapping before skipping the rest of link removal.

This directly addresses the root cause of stale link-to-`arvif` mappings when a link was only initialized but not created.
